title: Your first cross-window connection
problem: I have a page and an iframe that need to talk to each other, and raw postMessage keeps turning into stringly-typed guesswork that breaks in production.
outcome: A host page and a widget frame exchanging contract-checked messages over a handshaken session, with queueing across the pre-open gap, an origin rule, and a clean shutdown.

knowledge: A JavaScript project with a bundler
